```python
azimuth = np.arctan2(source_center[1], source_center[0])
opening = np.array([-np.sin(azimuth), np.cos(azimuth), 0.0])
tilted_plans = []
geometry = bot.status()['tool_geometry_reference']
for tilt in [35, 45]:
    t = np.deg2rad(tilt)
    approach = np.array([np.sin(t)*np.cos(azimuth), np.sin(t)*np.sin(azimuth), -np.cos(t)])
    R = np.column_stack((np.cross(opening, approach), opening, approach))
    corners = np.array([
        [x, y, z]
        for lo, hi in geometry['closed_pad_bounds_tool_m']
        for x in [lo[0], hi[0]]
        for y in [lo[1], hi[1]]
        for z in [lo[2], geometry['max_tip_z_m']]
    ])
    lowest_offset = (corners @ R.T)[:, 2].min()
    gz = surfaces['purple_top']['center_m'][2] - 0.005 - lowest_offset
    pz = gz + surfaces['orange_top']['center_m'][2] - source_support_z
    targets = {
        'grasp': dict(left_x=float(source_center[0]), left_y=float(source_center[1]), left_z=float(gz)),
        'placement': dict(left_x=float(destination_center[0]), left_y=float(destination_center[1]), left_z=float(pz)),
        'source_transfer': dict(left_x=float(source_center[0]), left_y=float(source_center[1]), left_z=float(pz + 0.02)),
        'destination_transfer': dict(left_x=float(destination_center[0]), left_y=float(destination_center[1]), left_z=float(pz + 0.02))
    }
    checks = {name: bot.plan_move(**target, rotation={'left': R}) for name, target in targets.items()}
    tilted_plans.append((R, targets, checks))
    print(tilt, checks)
```
